name: live-portfolio-tools
description: Verification gate for the live portfolio page (see BUILD_PLAN in docs/plans).

scripts.gate:dist: python3 ../build.py --out out/dist && node check.mjs --root out/dist --page index.html --local-only --no-webgl && node check.mjs --root out/dist --page index.html --local-only --budget
scripts.gate: node check.mjs --local-only && node check.mjs --no-webgl --local-only && node check.mjs --budget --local-only && npm run gate:dist
